Name: Rose's Comkiens Style Mead and Honey patch for BHM
Author: Roseloves109
Description: This is a compatibility patch I made for for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22848]Better Honey Mead[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url]. It enables the use of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url]’ honey and mead sprites while preserving the color changes and features from Better Honey Mead. Both mods must be installed for this to work. Credit to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/cometkins?gameId=1303]Comkiens [/url]for making the original art, They are talent Mod creator please check out their mod "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url]".
